name: New York to Lorient
description: Sailed alongside the IMOCA fleet of The Ocean Race Atlantic: New York to Lorient, ~3,200 nm across the North Atlantic, the first 50/50 gender-parity fully-crewed transatlantic race. Virtual start 14:00 UTC 2 Sep — the real gun, postponed from the planned start while the fleet cleared the marine-mammal go-slow areas out of New York. Exclusion zones (drawn red on the map) drag virtual boats to half speed inside. Polar: legacy (non-foiling) IMOCA 60 at 95% — the real foilers will be faster; the virtual fleet all sails the same numbers. Clearance marks south-east of Cape Race and off Penmarc'h keep the straight line at sea. Route yourself across: great circle vs. ridge-dodging is the whole game.
